data.name: Sanctu
data.description: Sanctu is a Brazilian reforestation startup that partners with low-income Amazonian smallholder farmers ("Guardians") to transform degraded land into biodiverse native forests. The company finances, provides technical assistance to, and commercializes output from these projects, generating revenue through the sale of carbon credits and bioproducts (fruits, seeds, oils) to corporate buyers working toward Net Zero targets.
